title: Split multi-invoice payments into separate rows in Excel report

requirements.text: Modify the Excel export logic to generate one row per invoice when a payment covers multiple invoices. Each row should duplicate the payment details (payment date, retailer code, retailer name, salesman, payment type, payment mode, transaction ID, bank name, cheque number, amount) but show only one invoice number per row.

quotes: Invoices check highlighted row..that I need in separate raw for each invoice just duplicate payments details both invoices in excel report

acceptanceCriteria: When a payment entry has multiple invoices (e.g., 'ABMNG-25-I102812, ABMNG-25-I104507'), each invoice appears on its own row in the exported CSV/Excel file
Payment details (date, retailer, salesman, type, mode, amount, transaction ID, bank, cheque number) are duplicated across all rows for that payment
The highlighted row example (ABMNG_D0553 with invoices ABMNG-25-I102812, ABMNG-25-I104507) exports as two separate rows with identical payment details but different invoice numbers
The invoice number column shows exactly one invoice number per row instead of comma-separated values

constraints: Preserve existing export functionality for single-invoice payments
Maintain the current column structure and ordering in the Excel export
Do not modify backend payment data structure or storage
nonGoals: Changing how payments are displayed in the UI tables
Modifying how payments are recorded or stored
Altering the summary totals calculation in the report
